    "High level of customization and flexibility for various workflows",

    "Scalable database features for tracking marketing campaigns"

  "cons": [
    "Steeper learning curve compared to more structured alternatives like monday.com",
    "Can become disorganized if not maintained diligently by a small team",
    "Customer support responsiveness could be improved for urgent issues"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As an owner of a small marketing agency, this individual found Notion to be a powerful and flexible tool for consolidating their team's notes, tasks, and project management needs. While appreciating its extensive customization, they likely experienced some initial challenges with its open-ended nature compared to their previous, more structured platform. The perceived value was good, though support could be a pain point for a small business needing quick resolutions."
